articles.title_en: The strategic determination of the supply of liquid assets
articles.title_cn: 流动资产供给的战略性决定
articles.abstract_en: We study asset liquidity in a model where financial assets can be liquidated for money in over-the-counter (OTC) secondary markets, in response to random liquidity needs. Traders choose to enter the market where they expect to find the best terms, understanding that their chances to trade depend on the entry decision of other investors. We find that small differences in OTC microstructure can induce very large differences in the relative liquidity of two assets. We use our model to rationalize, qualitatively and quantitatively, the superior liquidity of U.S. Treasuries over equally safe corporate debt.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个模型中的资产流动性，在该模型中，金融资产可以在场外交易（OTC）二级市场上变现为货币，以应对随机的流动性需求。交易者选择进入他们预期能找到最佳条件的市场，并理解他们的交易机会取决于其他投资者的进入决策。我们发现，OTC微观结构的微小差异可能导致两种资产相对流动性的巨大差异。我们使用我们的模型，定性和定量地解释了美国国债相对于同等安全公司债务的优越流动性。

articles.title_cn: 不确定性与不完全信息
articles.abstract_en: We study equilibrium determination in an environment where two types of agents have different information sets: Fully informed agents observe histories of all exogenous and endogenous variables. Less informed agents observe only a strict subset of the full information set and need to solve a dynamic signal extraction problem to gather information about the variables they do not directly observe. Both types of agents know the structure of the model and form expectations rationally. In this environment, we identify a new channel that generates equilibrium indeterminacy: Optimal information processing of the less informed agent introduces stable dynamics into the equation system that lead to self-fulling expectations. For parameter values that imply a unique equilibrium under full information, the limited information rational expectations equilibrium is indeterminate. We illustrate our framework with monetary policy models where an imperfectly informed central bank follows an interest rate rule.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个环境中均衡的决定，其中两类代理人拥有不同的信息集：完全知情的代理人观察所有外生和内生变量的历史。信息较少的代理人只观察完整信息集的一个严格子集，并且需要解决一个动态信号提取问题来收集关于他们未直接观察到的变量的信息。两类代理人都知道模型的结构并理性地形成预期。在这种环境中，我们确定了一个产生均衡不确定性的新渠道：信息较少的代理人的最优信息处理将稳定动态引入方程系统，导致自我实现的预期。对于在完全信息下意味着唯一均衡的参数值，有限信息理性预期均衡是不确定的。我们用货币政策模型来说明我们的框架，其中不完全知情的中央银行遵循利率规则。

articles.title_en: Employer reallocation during the COVID-19 pandemic: Validation and application of a do-it-yourself CPS
articles.title_cn: COVID-19疫情期间的雇主重新配置：DIY CPS的验证与应用
articles.abstract_en: Economists have recently begun using independent online surveys to collect national labor market data. Questions remain over the quality of such data. This paper provides an approach to address these concerns. Our case study is the Real-Time Population Survey (RPS), a novel online survey of the US built around the Current Population Survey (CPS). The RPS replicates core components of the CPS, ensuring comparable measures that allow us to weight and rigorously validate our results using a high-quality benchmark. At the same time, special questions in the RPS yield novel information regarding employer reallocation during the COVID-19 pandemic. We estimate that 26% of pre-pandemic workers were working for a new employer one year into the COVID-19 outbreak in the US, at least double the rate of any previous episode in the past quarter century. Our discussion contains practical suggestions for the design of novel labor market surveys and highlights other promising applications of our methodology.
articles.abstract_cn: 经济学家最近开始使用独立的在线调查来收集国家劳动力市场数据。关于此类数据质量的问题仍然存在。本文提供了一种解决这些担忧的方法。我们的案例研究是实时人口调查（RPS），这是一个围绕当前人口调查（CPS）构建的新型美国在线调查。RPS复制了CPS的核心组成部分，确保可比较的衡量指标，使我们能够使用高质量基准进行加权和严格验证。同时，RPS中的特殊问题提供了关于COVID-19疫情期间雇主重新配置的新信息。我们估计，在COVID-19疫情爆发一年后，疫情前工人中有26%正在为新雇主工作，至少是过去四分之一世纪中任何先前时期比率的两倍。我们的讨论包含了对新型劳动力市场调查设计的实用建议，并强调了我们的方法在其他有前景的应用。

articles.title_en: The promises (and perils) of control-contingent forward guidance
articles.title_cn: 控制条件前瞻指引的承诺（与风险）
articles.abstract_en: We develop a model with control-contingent forward guidance: the central bank explicitly anchors future policy announcements to short run inflation. Even though the model features past promises, we compute a closed form solution using a simple Markov chain representation. This allows us to show analytically that control-contingent forward guidance can rid the model of sunspot liquidity traps. The same holds for a policy of price level targeting, which emerges as a special case. Finally, we leverage this new framework to formally show that announced interest rates are only a means to an end: what truly matters is expected inflation.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个包含控制条件前瞻指引的模型：中央银行明确将未来的政策公告锚定于短期通胀。尽管模型包含过去的承诺，我们通过简单的马尔可夫链表示计算了闭式解。这使我们能够分析性地证明，控制条件前瞻指引可以消除模型中的太阳黑子流动性陷阱。价格水平目标政策同样如此，该政策作为特例出现。最后，我们利用这一新框架正式表明，公布的利率只是达到目的的手段：真正重要的是预期通胀。

articles.title_en: Commitment versus flexibility and sticky prices: Evidence from life insurance
articles.title_cn: 承诺与灵活性及价格粘性：来自人寿保险的证据
articles.abstract_en: Life insurance premiums display significant rigidity in the data, on average adjusting once every 3 years by more than 10%. This contrasts with the underlying marginal cost which exhibits considerable volatility due to the movements in interest and mortality rates. We build a dynamic model where policyholders are held-up by long-term insurance contracts, resulting in a time inconsistency problem for the insurer. The optimal contract balances commitment and flexibility and takes the form of a simple cutoff rule: premiums are rigid for cost realizations smaller than the threshold, while adjustments must be large and are only possible when cost realizations exceed it. We use a calibrated version of the model to show that it matches the data and captures several aspects of premium rigidity in the cross-section and over time.
articles.abstract_cn: 人寿保险保费在数据中表现出显著的粘性，平均每3年调整一次，调整幅度超过10%。这与潜在边际成本形成鲜明对比，后者因利率和死亡率的变动而表现出相当大的波动性。我们构建了一个动态模型，其中保单持有人被长期保险合同锁定，导致保险公司面临时间不一致问题。最优合同在承诺与灵活性之间取得平衡，并采取简单的阈值规则形式：当成本实现值低于阈值时，保费保持刚性；而当成本实现值超过阈值时，调整必须是大幅度的且仅在此情况下才可能发生。我们使用校准版本的模型来表明其与数据匹配，并捕捉了保费刚性在横截面和时间维度上的多个方面。

articles.title_en: The welfare effects of tax progressivity in a frictional labor market
articles.title_cn: 摩擦性劳动力市场中税收累进性的福利效应
articles.abstract_en: A progressive tax schedule is usually justified in terms of redistribution and insurance. When the labor market is frictional and there is no intensive margin of labor supply, progressive taxation has been shown to reduce unemployment by lowering wages. However, a more progressive tax schedule discourages the individual's supply of labor and (precautionary) savings, thus potentially reducing capital accumulation and total production.I examine the different effects of a progressive tax and transfer schedule on unemployment, labor income, an individual's labor supply, and savings. My modeling strategy follows Setty and Yedid-Levi (2020), who build on the workhorse model of Krusell et al. (2010), to which I add individual labor supply. I allow for ex ante heterogeneity in productivity, as well as in preferences, while the only idiosyncratic risk is the endogenous risk of unemployment. I compare my baseline model with a frictional labor market to one with a Walrasian labor market where the unemployment risk is exogenous.Steady state comparisons, based on a utilitarian welfare criterion, show that a tax and transfer schedule with a positive degree of progressivity is optimal in both frameworks, and that the presence of labor market friction implies that the optimal level of progressivity is (slightly) higher.
articles.abstract_cn: 累进税制通常以再分配和保险为由进行辩护。当劳动力市场存在摩擦且没有劳动供给的集约边际时，已有研究表明累进税通过降低工资来减少失业。然而，更累进的税制会抑制个人劳动供给和（预防性）储蓄，从而可能减少资本积累和总产出。我考察了累进税收和转移支付制度对失业、劳动收入、个人劳动供给和储蓄的不同影响。我的建模策略遵循Setty和Yedid-Levi（2020）的方法，他们基于Krusell等人（2010）的基准模型，我在此基础上加入了个人劳动供给。我允许生产率以及偏好存在事前异质性，而唯一的异质性风险是内生的失业风险。我将带有摩擦性劳动力市场的基准模型与失业风险外生的瓦尔拉斯劳动力市场模型进行比较。基于功利主义福利标准的稳态比较表明，在两种框架中，具有一定累进程度的税收和转移支付制度都是最优的，并且劳动力市场摩擦的存在意味着最优累进程度（略微）更高。

articles.title_en: On the coexistence of cryptocurrency and fiat money
articles.title_cn: 加密货币与法定货币的共存
articles.abstract_en: This paper uses a search-theoretic model to study conditions under which cryptocurrency is valued and under which it coexists with fiat money. In my model, a cryptocurrency economy is one in which private agents' decisions determine the stock of money and in which the marginal cost of producing money is increasing in the existing nominal stock. I show that the inflation rate of cryptocurrency must be zero in a stationary monetary equilibrium. This result is in sharp contrast to models with fiat money in which the stock of money is exogenously given. In fiat money economies, the inflation rate is determined by the rate of growth of the money stock. My result is also in sharp contrast with other types of private money economies, in which the inflation rate must necessarily be different from zero. In such private money economies, the cost of producing additional money does not depend on the existing nominal stock. Moreover, I show that cryptocurrency and fiat money can circulate at the same time and that the rates of return on these two assets may not be the same. Competition with cryptocurrency restricts the government's ability to over-issue fiat money and thereby might improve on pure fiat money equilibria without government commitment.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文使用搜索理论模型研究加密货币被赋予价值以及其与法定货币共存的条件。在我的模型中，加密货币经济是指私人主体的决策决定货币存量，且生产货币的边际成本随现有名义存量增加而增加的经济。我证明，在稳态货币均衡中，加密货币的通货膨胀率必须为零。这一结果与外生给定货币存量的法定货币模型形成鲜明对比。在法定货币经济中，通货膨胀率由货币存量的增长率决定。我的结果也与其他类型的私人货币经济形成鲜明对比，在这些经济中，通货膨胀率必然不为零。在这种私人货币经济中，生产额外货币的成本不依赖于现有的名义存量。此外，我证明加密货币和法定货币可以同时流通，且这两种资产的回报率可能不同。与加密货币的竞争限制了政府过度发行法定货币的能力，从而可能在没有政府承诺的情况下改善纯法定货币均衡。

articles.title_en: Should monetary policy target financial stability?
articles.title_cn: 货币政策是否应以金融稳定为目标？
articles.abstract_en: Monetary policy can promote financial stability and improve household welfare. We consider a macro model with a financial sector in which banks do not actively issue equity, output and growth depend on the aggregate level of bank equity, and equilibrium is inefficient. Monetary policy rules responding to the financial sector are ex-ante stabilizing because their effects on risk premia decrease the likelihood of crises and boost leverage during downturns. Stability gains from monetary policy increase welfare whenever macroprudential policy is poorly targeted. If macroprudential policy is sufficiently well-targeted to promote financial stability, then monetary policy should not target financial stability.
articles.abstract_cn: 货币政策可以促进金融稳定并改善家庭福利。我们考虑一个包含金融部门的宏观模型，在该模型中，银行不积极发行股票，产出和增长取决于银行股权的总量，且均衡是无效率的。对金融部门做出反应的货币政策规则具有事前稳定性，因为它们对风险溢价的影响降低了危机发生的可能性，并在经济低迷时期提升了杠杆率。当宏观审慎政策目标定位不佳时，货币政策带来的稳定性收益会增加福利。如果宏观审慎政策能够充分精准地以促进金融稳定为目标，那么货币政策就不应以金融稳定为目标。

articles.title_en: Long-term care needs and savings in retirement
articles.title_cn: 长期护理需求与退休储蓄
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, I investigate to what extent heterogeneity in both long-term care (LTC) needs and informal care support affects the savings decisions of the old. For this purpose, I develop and estimate a model of retired single individuals where agents are exposed to physical and/or cognitive health deterioration that triggers demand for LTC. To cope with LTC, agents differ in the amount of informal care provided by relatives and can purchase formal care at a market price to supplement this. I find that (i) LTC is relatively more important than bequest motives in explaining the lack of dissaving of individuals with limited access to informal care, (ii) concurrent cognitive and physical limitations account for most of the precautionary savings related to LTC, and (iii) Abstracting from informal care provision from relatives overestimates the welfare gains from expansions in government-provided means-tested care programs.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我研究了长期护理需求和非正式护理支持的异质性在多大程度上影响老年人的储蓄决策。为此，我开发并估计了一个退休单身个体模型，其中个体面临身体和/或认知健康恶化，从而引发对长期护理的需求。为了应对长期护理，个体在亲属提供的非正式护理数量上存在差异，并且可以按市场价格购买正式护理作为补充。我发现：（i）在解释无法获得非正式护理的个体缺乏消费减少方面，长期护理比遗赠动机相对更重要；（ii）认知和身体限制同时出现是长期护理相关预防性储蓄的主要原因；（iii）忽略亲属提供的非正式护理会高估政府提供的经济状况调查护理项目扩张的福利收益。

articles.title_en: Individual earnings and family income: Dynamics and distribution
articles.title_cn: 个人收入与家庭收入：动态与分布
articles.abstract_en: We review research on the dynamics and distribution of individual earnings and family income. We start with univariate earnings models, which dominate the literature and are often used as the exogenous component of family income in structural models of saving. We present a version of the linear model that nests most of the specifications that have been used in the literature, and then discuss recent papers that stress nonnormal shocks, nonlinear and age-dependent processes, and heterogeneous model parameters. The recent work provides a much richer description of the nature of earnings volatility than the basic model. We then turn to models of individual earnings that are based on wages, employment, job mobility, and hours. These multivariate models permit measuring the sources of permanent differences in earnings and distinguishing among shocks that influence earnings through employment, job mobility, general productivity, or hours. Finally, we consider models of lifetime family income that integrate individual earnings, marriage (accounting for marital sorting), and earnings of a spouse, if present. We conclude by discussing directions for future work.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们回顾了关于个人收入和家庭收入动态与分布的研究。我们从单变量收入模型开始，这些模型在文献中占主导地位，并常被用作储蓄结构模型中家庭收入的外生组成部分。我们提出了一个线性模型的版本，该模型涵盖了文献中使用的大多数规格，然后讨论了近期强调非正态冲击、非线性和年龄依赖过程以及异质性模型参数的论文。近期工作提供了比基本模型更丰富的收入波动性描述。然后我们转向基于工资、就业、工作流动性和工时的个人收入模型。这些多变量模型能够衡量收入永久性差异的来源，并区分通过就业、工作流动性、一般生产率或工时影响收入的冲击。最后，我们考虑整合个人收入、婚姻（考虑婚姻匹配）以及配偶收入（如有）的终身家庭收入模型。我们最后讨论了未来工作的方向。

articles.title_en: The fall of the labor income share: The role of technological change and hiring frictions
articles.title_cn: 劳动收入份额的下降：技术进步与招聘摩擦的作用
articles.abstract_en: Documenting an average drop of the labor share of eight percentage points for eight European countries and the US between 1980 and 2007, we analyze the role of technological progress and labor market frictions. According to our results, while capital-labor substitution in general was not crucial, Information Communication Technology (ICT) explains more than half of the decline in the labor share, given an estimated elasticity of substitution with the labor input of 1.18. Considering hiring costs slightly dampens the estimated substitution effect at aggregate level. Additionally, by modeling the substitution between ICT and labor with a set of key labor market variables, we find it to be linked to both the share of routine occupations (positively) and the share of high-skill workers (negatively) with a similar strength.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录了八个欧洲国家和美国在1980年至2007年间劳动份额平均下降八个百分点的情况，并分析了技术进步和劳动力市场摩擦的作用。根据我们的结果，虽然资本与劳动之间的替代总体上并不关键，但信息通信技术（ICT）解释了劳动份额下降的一半以上，其与劳动投入的替代弹性估计为1.18。考虑招聘成本在总体上略微削弱了估计的替代效应。此外，通过用一组关键的劳动力市场变量对ICT与劳动之间的替代进行建模，我们发现它与常规职业占比（正相关）和高技能工人占比（负相关）的联系强度相似。

articles.title_en: Diffusion of ideas in networks with endogenous search
articles.title_cn: 内生搜索网络中的思想扩散
articles.abstract_en: I study the diffusion of technology when the decision to search for productivity-enhancing technologies depends on the network of interactions between agents. Agents have the option to engage in costly learning from their first-degree connections. The more productive an agent's connections, the higher the gains from learning. Hence, the network affects the reservation productivity at which agents choose to learn and, therefore, affects aggregate productivity. I find that the denser the network, the higher total factor productivity and the lower inequality on average. This effect is due to less dispersed gains from learning across nodes when network density increases. Despite the increase in productivity, the share of agents that learn in equilibrium is not affected by network density.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了当搜索提高生产率技术的决策取决于代理人之间的互动网络时技术的扩散。代理人可以选择从其一级连接中进行成本高昂的学习。代理人的连接生产率越高，学习的收益就越大。因此，网络影响代理人选择学习的保留生产率，从而影响总生产率。我发现，网络越密集，全要素生产率越高，平均不平等程度越低。这种效应是由于网络密度增加时，各节点学习收益的分散程度降低。尽管生产率提高，但均衡中学习的代理人比例不受网络密度的影响。

articles.abstract_en: We document a new fact: regional divergence, the rate at which rich states grow faster than poor states, explains most U.S. house price movements since 1939, including the post-2000 boom-bust-boom cycle. An industry-share instrument provides evidence the relationship is causal, implying the location of economic growth affects national house prices. We propose a model to learn why regional divergence and house prices are related. In the model, high interstate inequality raises rents on average because relative demand for living in a high-income state increases and housing supply in low-income states is elastic. Regional divergence leads to higher expected future interstate inequality, which implies higher expected future rents, and therefore, higher current house prices. The model accurately predicts rents since 1929, which are quite different than prices, as well as cross-sectional moments of prices, rents, construction, and migration.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录了一个新事实：区域分化，即富裕州比贫穷州增长更快的速率，解释了自1939年以来美国房价的大部分变动，包括2000年后的繁荣-萧条-繁荣周期。一个行业份额工具提供了因果关系证据，表明经济增长的地理位置影响全国房价。我们提出了一个模型来理解区域分化与房价为何相关。在该模型中，高州际不平等平均提高了租金，因为对高收入州居住的相对需求增加，而低收入州的住房供给具有弹性。区域分化导致未来预期州际不平等加剧，这意味着未来预期租金上升，因此当前房价更高。该模型准确预测了自1929年以来的租金，这些租金与价格截然不同，同时也预测了价格、租金、建设和迁移的横截面矩。

articles.title_en: Disability insurance and the effects of return-to-work policies
articles.title_cn: 残疾保险与重返工作岗位政策的效果
articles.abstract_en: I provide a quantitative assessment of the labor market and welfare effects of return-to-work policies targeted at disability insurance (DI) recipients. I do so by estimating a life-cycle model in which individuals with different health evolving over time choose consumption, labor supply, and DI application. I find that a wage subsidy incentivizing return to work is welfare improving, and the willingness to pay for such reform is increasing in sickness and decreasing in wealth. This policy increases labor force participation of DI beneficiaries by 4.6 percentage points, and decreases the DI rate by 5.7 percentage points. A policy mandating a 10% yearly eligibility reassessment would decrease the welfare of individuals in bad health and poor economic condition, and force about 30% of the beneficiaries to exit the program, 54% of whom would return to work.
articles.abstract_cn: 我对针对残疾保险（DI）受益人的重返工作岗位政策的劳动力市场和福利效应进行了定量评估。为此，我估计了一个生命周期模型，其中健康状况随时间变化的不同个体选择消费、劳动供给和DI申请。我发现，激励重返工作的工资补贴能改善福利，对此类改革的支付意愿随疾病程度增加而增加，随财富减少而减少。该政策使DI受益人的劳动力参与率提高了4.6个百分点，并使DI率降低了5.7个百分点。一项要求每年进行10%资格重新评估的政策将降低健康状况不佳且经济条件较差的个体的福利，并迫使约30%的受益人退出该计划，其中54%的人将重返工作岗位。
